label.en: After the fleets of the Eternal Watchers are all destroyed

bridges.evidence: events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_2.txt:8652 ancrel.12065 trigger: from has_country_flag surveillance_bots and owns no other fleet; fired by on_fleet_destroyed_perp (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1669); the faction and its three fleets are created by the initializer surveillance_supercomputer_system (common/solar_system_initializers/special_system_initializers.txt:2024)

notes.zh: 该星系在新游戏开始时有可能生成：隐藏事件 ancrel.12050（on_game_start）以 2:1:1 抽签——什么都不发生 / 向银河边缘（50–100距离）生成 surveillance_supercomputer_system（经 ancrel.12055）/ 若有《初次接触》且难度与AI设置允许则改为生成“被选中者”星系（fircon.3500，另一个故事）。系统里有“永恒守望者”势力的三支守卫舰队，遗址在行星“观测终端”上由初始化器创建（common/solar_system_initializers/special_system_initializers.txt:2024）。
notes.en: The system may be spawned when a game starts: hidden ancrel.12050 (on_game_start) draws 2 : 1 : 1 between nothing, spawning surveillance_supercomputer_system at the galactic rim (distance 50-100, via ancrel.12055), and — with First Contact and permitting difficulty/AI settings — spawning the Chosen system instead (fircon.3500, another story). The system holds the faction "Eternal Watchers" with three guard fleets; the site on the planet "Observation Terminal" is created by the initializer (common/solar_system_initializers/special_system_initializers.txt:2024).

scope.zh: 整条故事：遗址的出现方式、全部阶段（按定义顺序）、最后结果及其互斥关系、掷骰失败时的事件池；中英文正文已读。
scope.en: Whole story: how the site appears, every stage in definition order, the final outcome(s) and their exclusivity, the roll-failure incident pool; both languages read.
